Team — quick commercial take and suggested compromise for negotiation with Acme: 

Summary proposal (commercial):
- Auto-renew: keep auto-renew but require Redwood to provide written renewal notice at least 60 days prior to renewal (we can commit to a second courtesy notice at 90 days if needed for Acme's procurement calendar).
- TFC (mutual): accept mutual Termination for Convenience with 60 days' notice and pro-rated refund for pre-paid amounts.
- Dedicated capacity carveout: where customer has reserved/dedicated capacity with a minimum commitment term (e.g., 6 months), apply a 6-month minimum notice or an equivalent break fee to cover allocated capacity costs.
- Transition assistance: Redwood to provide 30 days of standard transition assistance included; extended assistance (up to 60 days) billable at a pre-agreed reduced rate or convertible to CS hours.

Why this works: keeps commercial predictability for Redwood (reserve carveout), gives Acme flexibility at renewal, and keeps overall economics acceptable.

Attached: Commercial_Proposal_TFC.txt (plain-language bullets you can drop into the redline) and a short annotated version of Acme's PDF.

All — legal input and recommended redline language attached. High-level guidance: 

1) Auto-renew / notice: Acceptable compromise — keep auto-renew but amend notice timing to require Redwood to provide written non-renewal/renewal notice 90 days before renewal if Acme requests. We should add a clause requiring the customer to provide renewal direction at least 30 days before renewal date to be effective (prevents last-minute reversals).

2) Termination for Convenience: We can accept mutual TFC with 60 days' notice with the following protective carveouts: 
   - Dedicated/Reserved Capacity: if Acme has purchased dedicated capacity with a minimum commitment term, TFC will not apply during the non-cancellable commitment period; early termination during that window triggers a liquidated damages calculation equal to the remaining committed fees or an agreed break fee.
   - Refunds: Redwood will pro-rate any recurring fees and issue refunds or credits for unused prepaid service excluding any non-refundable setup or one-time charges noted in the order form.
   - Transition Assistance: Redwood will provide up to 30 days of transition assistance included; if Acme requires longer, we will provide up to 60 days at a reduced rate; CS will scope and confirm SOW prior to termination effective date.

3) Contract language: attached DOCX contains the exact snippet to insert. Please use the following DocuSign flow: 1) update OF, 2) send to Acme for review, 3) feed to legal for final sign-off. I also included a short fallback clause that allows Redwood to pause provisioning of new Dedicated capacity requests during the 60-day notice period if necessary to protect supply commitments.

Next steps: Ben — present the legal redline to Sara and Jordan tomorrow. Priya — confirm the accounting treatment for pro-rated refunds and any impact to revenue recognition; finance may need to approve the break fee mechanics. Sergio — copy me on the negotiation email.
